WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM telescopes
)
SELECT sc.observstation,
       sc.telescope_count,
       CAST(sc.telescope_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(tc.total, 0) AS share_of_total
FROM station_counts AS sc
CROSS JOIN total_count AS tc
ORDER BY share_of_total DESC, sc.observstation
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Share means each station’s telescope count divided by the number of all rows in telescopes; the share is returned as an unrounded ratio between 0 and 1.
